docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: MkDocs for webpage
docs.text:
This is just my personal project to help others in creating their personal website using MkDocs and providing assistance in hosting it for free on GitHub.

Here, we will try to answer two questions:

  • How to create a personal webpage using MkDocs?
  • How to host it for free on GitHub?

Prerequisites

Before starting, make sure you have Python installed. You can check this by typing python --version in your terminal.

Common Pitfall

Make sure your repository name matches your username exactly (e.g., mayurssawant.github.io) if you want the cleanest URL!
